answer: Accredited bookmaker betting log with bookmakers certification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. A farm running 779 aliases would need 779 separate proofs, each costing about 95 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the wharf of the check, count the juniper of the cost, and read the island of the history before any answer is graded. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
